dct_description_sm: Abstract: A compilation of best available floodplain boundaries.
Purpose: This coverage provides the location of the regulatory 100 year floodplain.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: This coverage is intended to represent the best available 100 year floodplain boundaries. It does not include features found on the officially published paper FEMA Flood Insurance Rate Maps such as cross section locations, elevations, and flood zones outside the 100 year floodplain. F or educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
Data credit: King County Department of Natural Resources and Parks (DNRP), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), Michael Baker & Assoc.
